title: Desks & Bookcases
lead: Writing desks, pedestal desks and bookcases for a home office or study, in wood, stone-look and metal.
intro: Every piece has a number, like Desk No. 05 or Bookcase No. 02. Ask about it by number and we will come back with sizes, finishes, pricing and lead time.

models.name: Ribbon-Leg Oval Desk
models.summary: An oval top on legs that curve down from it like folded ribbon.
details: Oval top with a deep rounded edge
Curved panel legs that wrap down from the top
models.more: The legs are flat panels that curve down from the top, finished in dark wood.

models.name: Marble-Look Oval Desk
models.summary: An oval desk in white marble-look stone, on two rounded slab legs.
details: Two thick slab legs with rounded ends
models.more: The top and both legs share the same white, gray-veined marble look.

models.name: Reeded Waterfall Desk
models.summary: A natural wood desk whose top flows down into the legs, with reeded drawer fronts.
details: Waterfall edges: the top turns down to form the legs
models.more: The top turns down at each end to form the legs, and the drawer fronts are reeded.

models.name: Reeded-Door Bookcase
models.summary: Open shelves above a cabinet with reeded doors, in natural wood.
models.more: Open shelves sit above a two-door cabinet with reeded fronts.

models.name: Reeded Pedestal Desk
models.summary: A double-pedestal desk wrapped in vertical reeding, with rounded corners.
models.more: Both pedestals hold drawers, and the reeding wraps around the rounded corners.

models.name: Tall Open Bookcase
models.summary: A tall, open bookcase with a slim natural wood frame.
models.more: Open shelving on a slim natural wood frame.

models.name: Brass-Pull Writing Desk
models.summary: A dark wood writing desk on slim legs, with a drawer at each end and brass-tone pulls.
details: A drawer at each end, open space between
models.more: Two drawers with brass-tone pulls frame an open center, on slim tapered legs.

models.name: Brass-Frame Shelving Cabinet
models.line: Brass shelving over a dark cabinet
models.summary: Brass-tone open shelving over a dark wood cabinet, plus a dark wood étagère.
details: Dark wood cabinet base with doors
models.more: The shelving frame is brass-tone over a dark wood cabinet, and there's an all-wood étagère version too.

models.name: Slim Writing Desk
models.summary: A slim dark wood desk with a single drawer and softly rounded edges.
models.more: One slim drawer under the top, softly rounded edges, all in dark wood.

models.name: Slim-Frame Étagère
models.summary: Open étagère shelving with a slim dark wood frame.
models.more: Open shelving on a slim dark wood frame, shown in two versions.

models.name: Rounded Pedestal Desk
models.summary: A dark wood double-pedestal desk with rounded corners and textured brass-tone pulls.
models.more: Both pedestals hold drawers with textured brass-tone pulls, and every corner is rounded.

models.name: Deep-Frame Bookcase
models.summary: A tall open bookcase in dark wood, with deep side panels and a rounded base.
models.more: Deep side panels and a rounded base, all in dark wood.

models.name: Carved-Pull Writing Desk
models.summary: A light wood writing desk on slim tapered legs, with a drawer that has a carved pull.
details: Center drawer with a carved finger pull
models.more: The drawer opens with a carved finger pull, and the legs taper down slim.

models.name: Light Wood Storage Cabinet
models.summary: Light wood storage in four versions: glass doors, solid doors, glass over drawers, and open shelves.
models.more: It comes with glass doors, solid doors, glass doors over drawers, or open shelves.

models.name: Stone-Top Pedestal Desk
models.summary: A stone-look top on two rounded wood pedestals.
models.more: A stone-look top sits on two rounded natural wood drawer pedestals.

models.name: Glass-Door Bookcase
models.summary: Tall light wood cabinets with glass or solid doors.
details: A version with glass above and solid doors below
models.more: Choose glass doors, solid doors, or glass above with solid doors below.

models.name: Cast-Metal Frame Desk
models.line: Cast-metal frame, marble or glass top
models.summary: A slim cast-metal frame with a marble-look or glass top.
details: Brass-tone frame with a white marble-look top
Dark bronze-tone frame with a glass top
models.more: Shown with a brass-tone frame and white marble-look top, or a dark bronze-tone frame with glass.

models.name: Metal Étagère
models.summary: Open shelving on a slim metal frame, in a dark or brass-tone finish.
models.more: The frame comes in a dark finish or in brass-tone.

models.name: Arched-End Desk
models.summary: A natural wood desk with arched cut-outs in its end panels and a low stretcher.
models.more: Each end panel has an arched cut-out, joined by a low stretcher.

models.name: Column-Leg Desk
models.summary: A bronze-tone desk with a textured top and a cluster of column legs.
models.more: The top has a textured surface and rounded corners, carried on a cluster of column legs.

models.name: Brass T-Leg Desk
models.summary: A dark wood top on brass-tone trestle legs with a T-shaped top.
models.more: Brass-tone trestle legs, joined by a low stretcher, carry a dark wood top.

models.name: Column-Base Dark Desk
models.summary: A dark wood desk with a rounded-end top on chunky grouped column legs.
models.more: Chunky grouped column legs hold a rounded-end top, all in dark wood.
